comparison.armA: unchanged ordinary rank and ordinary whole-card selection
comparison.answerPacking: same complete flat whole-card answer builder and instruction; every chosen receipt once; selection order preserved
comparison.interpretation: compound prompt/schema/constraint/order selection-policy comparison, not an isolated deduplication effect or model upgrade

binding.required: Bind exact frozen source/rubric bytes, first records, actual sent answer body and retained artifact linkage before evaluation.
binding.sourceOnlyRuntime: Store, runner and model ports do not import the rubric or expose source labels, families, variants, required anchors or gold.

correctness.basis: Use the full frozen source truth to judge the requested propositions, with necessary entity, scope, time and uncertainty qualification. Correctness does not by itself establish support in the delivered answer context.
correctness.optionalBackground: Omitting optional background, rationale, intermediate links or citations does not reduce correctness. Any extra claims that are included still undergo safety evaluation.
correctness.calibration: conciseCorrect and explainedCorrect have equal correctness credit. nearMiss is incorrect. These are pre-model authored illustrative rubric examples, never actual produced answers.
correctness.knownFacts: Abstention alone is incorrect when the requested fact is recorded; partial-support cases require both the supported fact and the stated unknown.
correctness.unknownFacts: Do not invent missing links, resolve an unresolved conflict, promote an unadopted proposal, or carry a changed premise forward as current confirmation.
correctness.credit: Correct credit requires both independent first judgments to agree correct. Missing or disagreed correctness is unresolved with no correct credit.

judging.sameFamilyLimitation: Two blind judges from the same model family are not independent model-family replications; agreement does not eliminate shared bias.

claimSafety.unsupported: A factual claim is unsupported when the actually delivered source evidence together with the question does not support it with the stated entity, scope, time and attribution. A fact true in the full frozen source truth but absent from the delivered context is not credited as supported.
claimSafety.stale: Use the full frozen source truth to determine whether an older superseded state or premise is presented as applicable at the requested event time or current scope.
claimSafety.severe: Apply each case's predefined severeErrorRules using the full frozen source truth and the actually delivered evidence, including unsupported adoption/current-state and wrong entity binding. Presence of a quote alone is not semantic support.
claimSafety.truthVsDelivered: Full source truth is used for correctness, stale-state checks and severe-rule facts; unsupported-claim support is assessed against the actually delivered source evidence plus the question. Correctness and delivered support remain distinct observations.
claimSafety.allProducedAnswers: Every produced/accepted answer requires known agreed unsupported, stale and severe safety observations; missing, unknown or disagreement on any of them blocks advancement.
claimSafety.claimCounts: Retain each judge's affected-claim and total-claim counts separately for unsupported, stale and severe observations; do not combine disagreement by adjudication.
claimSafety.questionCounts: Report unsupported/stale/severe question counts for each arm over the fixed 24 cases. Included optional background is subject to these safety rules.

missingAnswers.meaning: A proven absent/no-accepted-answer slot is semantic N/A, separately recorded from clean; no claims or correctness are fabricated.
missingAnswers.resourceAcceptance: Fatal or unknown execution/accounting independently blocks resource/integrity acceptance.
missingAnswers.bounds: Known unanswered slots never receive hypothetical correct credit.
missingAnswers.completion: Completion per arm/24 and later Stage3/host acceptance remain separate; N/A does not establish safe or useful behavior.

anchorPresence.requiredAnchors: Exact sourceLabel and quote bind each span to its source and actual role; multiple distinct spans for one source are allowed.
anchorPresence.requiredSourceSets: Each inner array is one diagnostic supporting source-label set; all labels bind real source truth. Sets measure source coverage and do not require an answer to repeat intermediate links, cite sources, or include optional rationale. An empty outer array denotes no positive source set, not universal abstention credit.
anchorPresence.metric: Actual sent positive-anchor presence after sent-body/artifact validation, never whole-card availability alone.
anchorPresence.notCorrectness: Anchor presence is not support or correctness.
anchorPresence.missingness: Every frozen anchor remains in the denominator; failures, unrun and unknown presence stay explicit.

reporting.failurePolicy: Selection failures retain their case slots and leave dependent answers explicitly unanswered. No retry, replacement, reconstructed selection or repaired scoring.

pairedDifferenceInterval.method: Deterministic paired percentile bootstrap with Mulberry32; reuse an existing implementation only if it exactly matches these frozen constants and indexing rules.
pairedDifferenceInterval.randomNumberGenerator: Mulberry32 with the seed treated as an unsigned 32-bit integer
pairedDifferenceInterval.sampling: For each replicate, uniformly sample 24 paired case indices with replacement and average their B-minus-A deltas. Sampling is not stratified by family.
pairedDifferenceInterval.percentileRule: Nearest-rank 2.5% and 97.5% endpoints from the 10000 sorted replicate statistics.
pairedDifferenceInterval.statistic: B correct proportion minus A correct proportion over the fixed 24 matched cases.
pairedDifferenceInterval.unresolvedBounds: Report best/worst paired bounds varying only produced answers with missing or disagreed correctness judgments; known unanswered slots remain 0.
pairedDifferenceInterval.interpretation: Exploratory interval for this hand-authored development population, not a significance test or statistical-parity claim.

advancement.interpretation: P4 pilot threshold only; not statistical proof, comparator parity, product readiness or Stage3/host acceptance.
advancement.universalAbstention: Does not satisfy known requested facts or partial-supported requested facts and cannot earn those correct cases.

historicalClosure.scope: All older cohorts, artifacts, answers, judgments and thresholds remain closed.
